title: Tennessee Small Estate Affidavit (2026): The New Limited Letters Process Up to $50,000
rank_math_title: Tennessee Small Estate Affidavit (2026): $50K, New Rules
rank_math_description: Tennessee replaced its small estate affidavit in 2023: a sworn petition for limited letters, $50,000 personal property, 45-day wait, bond or waiver.
pdf_outline: Worksheet: itemized personal property with values; creditor list with amounts
Bond waiver consent page for each adult heir/beneficiary

editor_notes: Tennessee does NOT allow transfer on death deeds (bills withdrawn 2026); the draft says so explicitly. Filing fees vary by county; not stated.
